<!-- ======================================================================
     SETUP -- LOAD DSA REPORT ARTEFACTS ONLY (zero recomputation)
     Every table, scalar and figure below was produced by
     aim1_report_dsa.Rmd and saved to output_dsa/slides/. This deck only
     formats values and includes the report's PNGs. Render through
     code/10_deterministic_dsa.R (render=only) or the Knit button.
     ====================================================================== -->

```{r load-artefacts, include=FALSE}
library(data.table); library(knitr); library(kableExtra)
if (!identical(params$render_token, "rendered-by-10_deterministic_dsa")) {
  stop("Render through dsa_render_documents() in code/10_deterministic_dsa.R (render=only) or the Knit button.")
}
slides_dir <- normalizePath(params$slides_dir, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
knit_first <- "Knit the DSA report first: Rscript code/10_deterministic_dsa.R render=only run_id=<run id> (renders aim1_report_dsa.Rmd, then this deck)."
if (!dir.exists(slides_dir) || !file.exists(file.path(slides_dir, "sl_manifest.rds"))) {
  stop("output_dsa/slides/ or its artefact manifest is missing. ", knit_first)
}
required <- c("sl_dsa_meta.rds", "sl_dsa_scenarios.rds", "sl_dsa_summary.rds", "sl_dsa_targets.rds",
              "sl_dsa_endpoints.rds", "sl_dsa_income.rds", "sl_dsa_tableS8.rds", "sl_dsa_dalys.rds",
              "sl_dsa_econ.rds", "sl_dsa_validation.rds", "sl_scalars.rds", "sl_tab_summary.rds",
              "sl_tab_region.rds", "sl_tab_top15.rds", "sl_bod_summary.rds", "sl_control_summary.rds",
              "sl_control_scalars.rds", "sl_econ_vsl_primary.rds", "sl_econ_vsly_primary.rds",
              "sl_econ_scalars.rds", "sl_dsa_tornado.png", "sl_dsa_annual.png", "sl_dsa_trajectories.png",
              "sl_dsa_trend_deaths.png", "sl_fig_baseline_trend.png", "sl_fig_asmr.png",
              "sl_fig_deaths_averted.png", "sl_fig_cum_averted.png", "sl_fig_by_cause.png",
              "sl_fig_by_age.png", "sl_fig_top15_countries.png", "sl_fig_control_split.png",
              "sl_econ_dotplot.png")
man_sl <- as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(slides_dir, "sl_manifest.rds")))
miss <- setdiff(required, man_sl$file)
if (length(miss)) stop("Slide artefacts missing from the report manifest: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "), ". ", knit_first)
if (!all(file.exists(file.path(slides_dir, man_sl$file)))) {
  stop("Listed slide artefacts not found: ", paste(man_sl$file[!file.exists(file.path(slides_dir, man_sl$file))], collapse = ", "), ". ", knit_first)
}
if (uniqueN(man_sl$run_id) != 1L || (nzchar(params$run_id) && !identical(unique(man_sl$run_id), params$run_id))) {
  stop("Slide artefacts belong to run ", paste(unique(man_sl$run_id), collapse = ", "), ", not ", params$run_id, ". ", knit_first)
}
md5_now <- unname(tools::md5sum(file.path(slides_dir, man_sl$file)))
if (!identical(md5_now, man_sl$md5)) {
  stop("Slide artefacts changed after the report wrote them: ", paste(man_sl$file[md5_now != man_sl$md5], collapse = ", "), ". ", knit_first)
}
rd <- function(f) { x <- readRDS(file.path(slides_dir, f)); if (is.data.frame(x)) setDT(x); x }
meta <- rd("sl_dsa_meta.rds")
if (!identical(meta$run_id, unique(man_sl$run_id))) stop("sl_dsa_meta.rds does not match the manifest. ", knit_first)
sl <- rd("sl_scalars.rds"); sl_control_scalars <- rd("sl_control_scalars.rds"); sl_control_summary <- rd("sl_control_summary.rds")
sl_tab_summary <- rd("sl_tab_summary.rds"); sl_tab_region <- rd("sl_tab_region.rds"); sl_bod <- rd("sl_bod_summary.rds")
sl_econ_vsly <- rd("sl_econ_vsly_primary.rds"); sl_econ_vsl <- rd("sl_econ_vsl_primary.rds"); sl_econ <- rd("sl_econ_scalars.rds")
dsa_scen <- rd("sl_dsa_scenarios.rds"); dsa_sum <- rd("sl_dsa_summary.rds"); dsa_tg <- rd("sl_dsa_targets.rds")
dsa_ep <- rd("sl_dsa_endpoints.rds"); dsa_inc <- rd("sl_dsa_income.rds"); dsa_s8 <- rd("sl_dsa_tableS8.rds")
dsa_daly <- rd("sl_dsa_dalys.rds"); dsa_econ <- rd("sl_dsa_econ.rds"); dsa_val <- rd("sl_dsa_validation.rds")
# LaTeX cannot resolve the repository path (spaces), so PNGs are copied next to the deck.
local_png <- function(f) { stopifnot(file.copy(file.path(slides_dir, f), f, overwrite = TRUE)); f }
png <- setNames(lapply(grep("[.]png$", required, value = TRUE), local_png), grep("[.]png$", required, value = TRUE))

fmt_M <- function(x, digits = 1) formatC(round(x / 1e6, digits), format = "f", digits = digits, big.mark = ",")
fmt_pct <- function(x, digits = 1) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0 || is.na(x)) return("[n/a]")
  paste0(formatC(round(x * 100, digits), format = "f", digits = digits), "\\%")
}
fmt_trillions <- function(x, digits = 1) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0 || is.na(x)) return("[n/a]")
  paste0("\\$", formatC(round(x / 1e12, digits), format = "f", digits = digits, big.mark = ","), " T")
}
tex <- function(x) {
  for (ch in c("&", "%", "_", "#", "$")) x <- gsub(ch, paste0("\\", ch), x, fixed = TRUE)
  x
}
ktab <- function(d, fs = 7, align = NULL) {
  kable(d, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, escape = TRUE, align = align) |>
    kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position", "scale_down"), font_size = fs) |> row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)
}
digits <- if (sl$total_all < 5e6) 3 else 1
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.align = "center",
                      out.width = "\\linewidth")
```

# Study Overview

## Aim 1 Deterministic Sensitivity Analysis

`r if (isTRUE(meta$is_pilot)) paste0("\\begin{alertblock}{PILOT RUN (", tex(meta$run_id), ")}\\small ", meta$n_countries, " of ", meta$n_eligible, " countries (", tex(paste(meta$countries, collapse = ", ")), "). Software-verification results only: \\textbf{not global estimates}.\\end{alertblock}") else ""`

\begin{block}{Question}
How robust are the projected deaths averted by the WHO cardiovascular targets to \textbf{achievement}, \textbf{timing}, \textbf{statin adherence} and \textbf{CVD mortality-trend} assumptions?
\end{block}

\begin{columns}[T]
\begin{column}{0.5\textwidth}
\textbf{Design} (Briggs et al., ISPOR-SMDM 2012)
\begin{itemize}\footnotesize
  \item One-way deterministic scenarios around the \textbf{active base case}
  \item Every setting re-runs the country-level model (`r meta$n_countries` countr`r ifelse(meta$n_countries == 1, "y", "ies")`, 6 scenarios, 2017--2050)
  \item Chosen scenario values, \alert{not} probability distributions: ranges are \textbf{not} confidence intervals
\end{itemize}
\end{column}
\begin{column}{0.46\textwidth}
\begin{exampleblock}{Reference = active base case}
\footnotesize BP: 150M additional controlled by 2030 $\cdot$ statins `r tex(meta$ref_statin)` $\cdot$ statin adherence IR/CF \textbf{`r tex(meta$ref_adherence)`} (not 1.0) $\cdot$ CVD CF trend at 80\% $\cdot$ background trend on
\end{exampleblock}
\end{column}
\end{columns}

## DSA Settings

```{r dsa-scenarios, results='asis'}
ktab(dsa_scen[, .(Setting, Family, `What changes`)], fs = 7)
```

\footnotesize Income-group adherence (L 0.50/0.65, LM 0.60/0.70, UM 0.70/0.80, H 0.80/0.90) is an \textbf{illustrative assumption}. Perfect adherence (1.00/1.00) is an extra reference, never the anchor.

# Scenarios

## Four WHO Priority Targets (Reference)

```{r scenario-table, results='asis'}
dt_scen <- data.table(
  N = 1:4,
  WT = c("150M more with HTN controlled by 2030", "$\\geq$50\\% eligible adults on lipid-lowering therapy by 2030",
         "80\\% BP control among diagnosed diabetics by 2030", "80\\% availability of validated BP devices"),
  Sc = c(paste0("\\textbf{HTN Control (Combined)}: ", fmt_M(sl_control_scalars$add_total, digits), "M = ",
                fmt_M(sl_control_scalars$add_no_diabetes, digits), "M without + ", fmt_M(sl_control_scalars$add_diabetes, digits), "M with diabetes"),
         "\\textbf{Improved Statin Uptake}: 50\\% coverage by 2030", "\\textbf{HTN Control (Diabetes)}: 0.80 ceiling (full target only)",
         "Embedded in HTN scenarios"))
kable(dt_scen, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE, col.names = c("\\#", "WHO Target", "Modelled Scenario")) |>
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position", "scale_down"), font_size = 7) |> column_spec(2, width = "4.5cm") |> column_spec(3, width = "6cm")
```

\vspace{4pt}\footnotesize The two BP subgroups combine additively; the BP composite combines multiplicatively with statins.

# Discussion

## Interpretation

\begin{columns}[T]
\begin{column}{0.55\textwidth}
\textbf{What the one-way settings show}
\begin{itemize}\footnotesize
  \item Target achievement (50\%/75\% of the increment) scales benefits roughly in proportion to the achieved increment
  \item Delaying the full endpoint to 2035/2040 loses early benefits; effects converge once the endpoint is reached
  \item Statin adherence moves statin-driven benefits only; BP benefits are unchanged
  \item The CVD case-fatality trend regime changes both BAU and intervention deaths; compare within regimes
\end{itemize}
\end{column}
\begin{column}{0.43\textwidth}
\begin{alertblock}{Interpretation rule}
\footnotesize Deterministic scenario spreads describe the consequences of named assumptions; they are not probability statements or confidence intervals.
\end{alertblock}
\end{column}
\end{columns}

## Limitations of the DSA

\begin{itemize}\footnotesize
  \item One-way settings only; no multi-way stress tests or probability weights
  \item Income-group statin adherence values are illustrative (no sourced income-specific estimate in the repository)
  \item No separate BP-medication adherence: BP targets are achieved control, which already embodies adherence
  \item The cause-specific background-mortality trend input has no post-2019 values, so only the all-cause envelope (BG.mx.all) trends, in every regime alike
  \item The reference CVD trend series starts above the 2019 level for IHD and ischemic stroke; the IHME Foresight trend is global, cause-level and age-standardised
  \item Active statin CF adherence 0.664 vs 64.4\% reported for secondary prevention by Basios et al.\ 2025 (kept to reproduce the pipeline)
\end{itemize}

# Appendix

## Notation: Core Model and HTN Control

\begin{center}{\scriptsize
\begin{tabular}{ll}
\toprule
Symbol & Description \\
\midrule
$W, K, D$ & Well, Sick, Dead populations \\
$IR$, $CF$ & Baseline incidence \& case-fatality rates \\
$\varepsilon_{IR,j}$, $\varepsilon_{CF,j}$ & Multiplicative effect ratios for intervention $j$ \\
$BG.mx$, $BG.mx.all$ & Cause-specific \& all-cause background mortality \\
$c_{g,0}$, $c_{g,t}$, $c_{g,\text{target}}$ & Baseline, time-$t$, target control, subgroup $g\in\{N,D\}$ \\
$f$ & DSA fraction of the increment: $c^{DSA}_{\text{target}} = c_0 + f\,(c_{\text{target}} - c_0)$ \\
$T$ & Endpoint year: $c_t = c_0 + (c_{\text{target}} - c_0)\min[\max(0, (t-2025)/(T-2025)), 1]$ \\
$e_{g,t}$ & $E_g (c_{g,t} - c_{g,0}) / (1 - E_g c_{g,0})$ \\
$w_D$ & Diabetes share among hypertensives; $\varepsilon_{IR,\text{BP}} = 1 - (1-w_D) e_{N,t} - w_D e_{D,t}$ \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
}\end{center}

## Statin Therapy and Adherence

\footnotesize
\begin{columns}[T]
\begin{column}{0.5\textwidth}
\textit{Incremental coverage above baseline $U_{0,\ell}$ (DSA endpoint $T$):}
$$\Delta U(t,\ell) = \Delta U_{\text{target},\ell}\,\min\!\left[\frac{t-2026+1}{T-2026+1},1\right]$$
$\Delta U_{\text{target},\ell} = \max(U^{DSA}_{\text{target}} - U_{0,\ell}, 0)$, $U^{DSA}_{\text{target}} = U_0 + f\,(0.50 - U_0)$
\end{column}
\begin{column}{0.48\textwidth}
\textit{Adherence $a_{IR}$, $a_{CF}$ enter both numerator and baseline denominator:}
$$E^{IR} = \frac{AF\,\delta^{IR}\,\Delta U\,a_{IR}}{1 - \delta^{IR}\,U_0\,a_{IR}},\quad E^{CF} = \frac{\delta^{CF}\,\Delta U\,a_{CF}}{1 - \delta^{CF}\,U_0\,a_{CF}}$$
Reference $a_{IR} = `r ifelse(is.null(meta$ref_adherence), "", sub(" / ", "$, $a_{CF} = ", meta$ref_adherence))`$.
\end{column}
\end{columns}
